plugins.name: muggle
plugins.description: Real-browser E2E acceptance for your coding agent: test the flows you changed and open the PR with screenshots. Built for flows other tools can't reach: managed test identities with live inboxes (magic links, email OTP and 2FA, verification mail, password resets), an encrypted secret store for login and test credentials, and a test graph that runs prerequisite flows first. Plain-English tests become replayable scripts on localhost or preview URLs.
